title: Perry Lowe on PerioStōm, BioArmor, and Premier Dental Products’ Innovation
html:
In this episode of Speaking of Dentistry… The Editor’s Cut with Stan Goff, Stan Goff, Senior Managing Editor of Dentistry Today, interviews Perry Lowe, CEO of Premier Dental Products and Premier Medical Manufacturing.

Lowe discusses Premier Dental Products’ exclusive distribution partnership with Forward Science for PerioStōm, a product designed to support tissue recovery after scaling and root planing. He explains how Premier evaluates new dental technologies, why clinical evidence and ease of integration into existing workflows matter, and how education will help clinicians understand the product’s benefits.

Lowe also discusses Premier’s continued investment in research and development, including its BioArmor antimicrobial composite technology, and shares his perspective on the company’s evolving approach to clinically meaningful innovation.

Sponsored by Premier Dental Products

Watch the full conversation to learn more about Premier’s latest developments in dental materials and periodontal care.
